name: wicare
description: WiCare — local, software-simulated wireless patient-monitoring system

scripts.predev: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/scenarios/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/network-emulator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/patient-generator/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/scenarios/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/network-emulator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/patient-generator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/service/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && next build apps/web
scripts.pretest: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/scenarios/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/network-emulator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p simulator/patient-generator/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p simulator/scenarios/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p simulator/network-emulator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p simulator/patient-generator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p simulator/service/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
